sara (eng-release): Quick heads up — planned rollout starting in 40m. Order: router -> runtime -> console. Canary 5% for 10m, then 25% for 20m if green. No DB/schema changes.
sara (eng-release): Pin proposals: router:v4.0.1, runtime:v3.1.2 (kernel-change), console:2.9.0. Need signoff on kernel flip.
josh (runtime): kernel-change is the risky bit. It reduces mem by 12% but we've only smoke-tested on short sequences. My ask: add p99 latency and 5xx thresholds and a quick perf-run during canary.
meera (console): UI migration is non-blocking but console has a new telemetry tag that router needs to surface, will push a minor patch at cutover.
ryan (router): Router handshake is unchanged; I'll keep sticky routing to previous variant for 1h post-cutover to avoid cold-KV thrash.
sara (eng-release): OK. Rollback criteria proposal: any of these during canary window -> automatic rollback: 1) 5xx rate delta > 0.5% absolute, 2) p99 latency increase > 200ms and trending up, 3) failed handshake rate > 0.2% for router -> trigger full rollback. Thoughts?
josh (runtime): +1. Also add: if KV hit rate drops > 10% for runtime caches, rollback. That's been a failure mode before.
meera (console): +1 from console. I'll pause the telemetry flip until runtime is stable.
sara (eng-release): Good. Deploy bot will run staged rollouts. Deploy plan snippet:```
deploy-bot start --canary 5 --duration 10m --escalate 25 --duration 20m --pin router=v4.0.1 runtime=v3.1.2 console=2.9.0
```
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted. Canary window starts at 2026-03-21T02:40:00Z. Job ID: db-6083.
deploy-bot: Canary started: router=v4.0.1 runtime=v3.1.2 console=2.9.0 -> 5% traffic. Monitoring hooks enabled: grafana/eng-runtime, dashboards/console, router-handshake.
alexa (oncall): Running smoke load now (+1k requests/min) against canary. Will report p50/p95/p99 at +2m.
josh (runtime): Seeing p99 spike at +3m -> +180ms from baseline, but p95 steady. KV miss rate +4%. Not alarming yet but watching.
sara (eng-release): Keep watchers ready. If p99 > 200ms or 5xx trend up, hit rollback.
ryan (router): router handshake errors bumped to 0.15% at +4m — still under threshold but close.
meera (console): console telemetry is fine. No failed feature flags.
deploy-bot: Alert: p99 latency crossed 200ms for runtime (job db-6083) at +6m. Observed: p99 +230ms, 5xx stable. Rolling decision required.
sara (eng-release): Decision — abort kernel-change in runtime. Josh, can you pin runtime back to v3.0.9 and kick immediate rollback for runtime only? Keep router and console canary running.
josh (runtime): On it. Executing: `deploy-bot rollback --job db-6083 --service runtime --to v3.0.9 --reason "p99 spike kernel-change"`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for runtime -> v3.0.9. Canary traffic for runtime diverted to pinned v3.0.9 within 45s.
josh (runtime): p99 back to baseline within 90s. KV rates normalized.
sara (eng-release): Great — we keep router and console canary at 5% and observe for full 10m. We'll note kernel-change needs longer perf testing.
meera (console): I'll update release notes draft to mark runtime kernel-change as postponed and add rollback reason. Link: https://redwood.infra/docs/releases/2026-03-21/notes-draft
ryan (router): Router canary healthy. Handshake errors dropped to 0.04% after runtime rollback.
sara (eng-release): Final: continue canary to 10m, if green escalate to 25% for 20m. Add postmortem action: longer sequence perf suite for kernel flips. Assign to @josh.
meera (console): I'll publish release notes after canary passes.
alexa (oncall): I'll keep monitoring for 1h post-rollout. Filing follow-up ticket: INF-1428 for kernel-change perf harness.
sara (eng-release): Thanks everyone. Closing thread once 25% ramp or full rollback. :thumbsup:
